text:
sam: Heads up — planning a schema change tonight for events.event_type (nullable -> NOT NULL). Migration + backfill in the 00:00-02:00 UTC change window. Need lock/backfill plan.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by sam for 2025-11-03 00:30 UTC. Change window: 00:00-02:00 UTC. Canary target: 5% traffic.

nina: Estimated 120M rows. Backfill will take ~4–6h if done fully online. We can do short exclusive lock for ALTER, then background copy for the rest.

alex: Could we do CREATE TABLE + COPY + swap to avoid long locks?

dba-sre: For this schema we also need FK validation which blocks swap approach unless we defer validation. validate_concurrently might still scan a lot.

sam: Proposal: canary apply on replica at 00:15, primary ALTER with exclusive brief lock 00:45-00:50 (aim <60s), then chunked backfill with rate limiting. If canary errors, rollback and revert feature flag.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggers: >5% 5xx on canary, replication lag >1s during migration, or p99 latency increase >300ms sustained 5m. Auto-rollback enabled.

carol: I'll be on-call for the window and watch traces + error budget. Add me to post-run checks. :eyes:

nina: Lock timing estimate: exclusive lock per partition 30s-90s. We'll pre-create indexes and ensure statement_timeout is set to 2m.

alex: Feature flag note — pin service to version v2025-11-03-1 during rollout so that we can toggle quickly. Sam, can you add pin?

sam: Yup — will pin in release config and create route override in Console before the canary.

bob: Also request: pause autoscalers + background workers that touch events during backfill window to avoid racing/cost spikes.

nina: I'll run a small dry-run on staging at 22:00 UTC and post timing. Plan to run VACUUM/ANALYZE with low IO priority after backfill.

dba-sre: Quick runbook excerpt:
```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN event_type_tmp text;
-- backfill in chunks by id range
UPDATE events SET event_type_tmp = event_type WHERE event_type_tmp IS NULL LIMIT 10000;
-- once ready, swap columns under brief lock
ALTER TABLE events DROP COLUMN event_type;
ALTER TABLE events RENAME COLUMN event_type_tmp TO event_type;
COMMIT;
```

sam: I'll create the runbook link and post it here. Also will include rollback SQL and monitoring dashboard links.

deploy-bot: Checklist: db-migration-runner v2.4, binlog lag <100ms, canary success, SRE oncall signed off.

bob: Reminder: add a DB freeze comment in autoscaling policy to prevent sudden node churn.

sam: Agreed. Lock plan set. Dry-run results + final runbook link will be posted after staging test.

nina: staging dry-run done: partition X took 42s for exclusive swap, chunked backfill throughput ~12k rows/s. Posting results: https://go/runbooks/migration-1830123456

sam: Thanks — will proceed with scheduling and post final confirmation 30m before window starts. :thumbsup:
